title: Signposts for the Roads

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Summer's here, and the roads out of the valley are dry and open. Folk will be walking them all summer long!

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: But a walker needs signposts. I've cut the boards. Will you help me paint the words on them?

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: Every signpost painted. Nobody will lose their way this summer!

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: Fine lettering! We'll set these up where the roads leave the valley. When you walk past one, you'll know you made it.

journal_line: I painted words on the new signposts with Mr. Amos.
